newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar seeks to change note terms.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar seeks to change note terms.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc said it will begin soliciting consents for certain amendments to indentures underlying its outstanding debt securities.

The amendments would modify the indentures to increase the principal amount of secured debt that may be incurred and the value of sale and leaseback transactions that may be entered into by the company, heavy equipment maker Cateprillar said.
Caterpillar said it thinks the modifications will increase its flexibility to consider alternative financings.
The solicitation will be open until at least November 12 to holders of record October 22, Caterpillar said.
The consent of holders of 66.67 in principal amount of each series is required to approve the amendments for the series, the company said.
Chase Securities Inc is the solicitation agent.
